description:
Responsibilities:  
- Design, build, and support integrations using ODI to implement data and master data flows across multiple systems and technologies such as Oracle, Hyperion Planning, Essbase, DRM, and HFM 
- Provide technical expertise during requirements gathering and analysis, document technical designs and support manuals, and drive test and deployment processes 
- Identify, design, develop, and implement fixes and enhancements to existing production integrations 

 Minimum qualifications:  
- BS/BA degree (In lieu of degree, 4 years of relevant work experience) 
- Strong scripting skills (Borne Shell, Python, etc.) 
- Strong relational database modeling (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL) 
- 4+ years of hands-on ODI development experience (or 6 years of relevant experience with similar tools e.g. Informatica) 
- 4+ years Data Warehouse experience 
- Expertise using Topology, Knowledge Modules, Change Data Capture, Metadata, Web Services and SOA. 
- Expertise in Advanced PL/SQL 
- Expertise building ETL processes from scratch 
- Experience in performance tuning, partitioning strategies. 

 Preferred qualifications:  
- BS/BA in Information Systems or Computer Science 
- Experience designing, building, and supporting data integrations that involve highly sensitive financial data 
- Exposure to OLAP/BI tools such as: Hyperion EPM suite and OBIEE 
- Good understanding of oracle database such as partitioning, materialized view, explain plan etc 
- Good understanding of protocols (e.g. SFTP, HTTPS, SOAP) and system integration methods (e.g. Web Service, REST service) 
- Experience in Oracle BI Application such as financial analytics.

 

 THANKS AND REGARDS,
 ASMA KHAN SURI


 Must be able to pass a background and drug screen
